properties.description: Implemented shared-checkout check activity and result refresh. Checks now show queued/running states, elapsed time while running and frozen final duration through the shared result status component. Run reflects the authoritative checkout lock and refreshes after other sessions finish, including a retry after user interaction interrupts rendering. Preserved cancellation and checkout locking. Reproduced absent progress and stale disabled Run with authored browser input and persistent exact before/after recordings. Focused backend, portable result model and browser tests pass; real component-check results update without page reload and recorded screenshots remain accessible from the buildspace context. build.ps1 passed, including 939 authored source files with zero type-safety violations. Inspected running/completed screenshots. With explicit user authorization, stopped the active operation through Broccoli and completed guarded restart. Live check-state endpoint confirms unlocked checkout, 11 recorded runs and no active checks. Full test:all checkpoint was not run for this focused review iteration. Ready for the parent's human review.
